Use case: stylized-concept. Production background art for a Japanese full-color manga-style animal-adventure medal game, a modest island harbor postal service. Polished hand-drawn game illustration, convincing dimensional light and shadows, controlled detailed textures, deep forest green painted equipment, white plaster, restrained natural wood and cool blue sea. Clean neutral whites, NO sepia, NO yellow filter, no aged paper. Wide landscape 16:9 composition. Eye-level fixed camera, spacious low-detail foreground for superimposed character cutouts, uncluttered upper center for speech balloons. Architectural perspective consistent, tasteful lived-in spaces, quiet specific place rather than generic fantasy. No people, no animals, no characters, no letters/words, no logos, no speech bubbles, no interface, no reward numbers. One single cohesive scene, not a collage.

sprites: NAGI young river otter courier, brown fur and cream muzzle, long thick tail, green rolled-sleeve jacket over white shirt and brown crossbody satchel. Normal: friendly waving with open manga eyes. Surprise: holding route map, wide graphic manga eyes and small angular gasp. Joy: letter held up, happy arc eyes, exuberant manga smile. Disappointed: shoulders dropped, satchel hugged, sad manga brows and mouth, eyes remain readable rather than sleepy.

MINA white-and-grey gull courier with yellow beak and long bird legs, green scarf, brown leg message pouch. Wings not human hands. Normal: one wing pointing, alert open manga eyes. Surprise: lifted foot, wide manga eyes, angular open beak. Joy: raised wings, happy arc eyes, open beak. Disappointed: wings and head lowered, sad manga brows and modest downturned beak.

GARO adult tall broad-shouldered badger mechanic, black-white facial stripes, green rolled-sleeve jacket over white shirt, brown work apron, boots and spanner. Normal: folded arms, composed OPEN manga eyes. Surprise: raised palms and clearly wide graphic manga eyes. Joy: spanner and thumbs up, bold manga smile and happy arc eyes. Disappointed: one hand behind neck, apologetic sad brows and a small downward mouth. Mature but not permanently squinting.
